english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something by one's own choice rather than under pressure.

exampleSentences.english: I am doing this work voluntarily; nobody is forcing me.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢啲工作我係自己願意做嘅，冇人逼我。
